test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 5 persons C, D, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only C and F are to the left of D. Only H is to the right of G. F is at one of the extreme ends of the row. How many persons are sitting between F and G?
solution:
Given: Five persons C, D, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing north.

Only C and F are to the left of D.

Only H is to the right of G.

F is at one of the extreme ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6866a6d3372353a2dc74dd2cecb469c40553849070051ba0f30bc5f617948477.png] 

Now, persons between F and G = 2 persons.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
